crossRefs.note: Unless the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely now you would have…
I will give this people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, and it will happen that when you go, you shall not go…
For they are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. They shall not be sold as slaves.
Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.
Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.
“Woe to him who builds his house by unrighteousness, and his rooms by injustice; who uses his neighbor’s service…
I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers…
Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.

translations.web: When you let him go free from you, you shall not let him go empty.
translations.bsb: And when you release him, do not send him away empty-handed.
translations.kjv: And when thou sendest him out free from thee, thou shalt not let him go away empty:
translations.asv: And when thou lettest him go free from thee, thou shalt not let him go empty:
